== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omal Escalon is an individual associated with the [[Escalon Company]], a mid-level interplanetary corporation. He grew up in a concrete environment and spends much of his time in a glass and [[steel]] palace. Omal has expressed an interest in undergoing augmentations, even suggesting he would enjoy being transformed into a freak to match others. He possesses physical traits such as the ability to sprout extra hands and stretch his neck like a snake. His presence on a planet has been significant enough to trigger immediate warnings to planetary security. Omal is also linked to [[Aila Escalon]] and has been involved in testing the ship known as [[The Last Horizon]]. Additionally, he provided transportation for [[Omega]] for a day.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Omal Escalon tests [[The Last Horizon]] against [[Aila Escalon]] and [[Hallow Divide]]. His presence on the planet also prompted [[Lutoch Terelle]] to issue an emergency warning. Additionally, Omal picked up [[Lemon]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Known as Mister Escalon, Omal is a gunslinger characterized by an orange artificial eye that shines with light and the supernatural ability to sprout multiple smiles and hands. During testing of [[The Last Horizon]], he faced off against [[Hallow Divide]] and [[Aila Escalon]]. His arrival on the edge of a [[VMC]], accompanied by wind and [[Shadow|shadow]], was significant enough to cause [[Lutoch Terelle]] to issue an emergency warning.}}
